text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 35::Three years.
]


On a bill of exchange or promissory note payable on demand and not accompanied by any writing restraining or postponing the right to sue.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the bill or note.
